system.effect: This item deals Bludgeoning weapon Damage. Once per turn, after a weapon attack using it causes at least one Wound to a creature, reduce that creature’s Fortitude by 1 until the start of your next Turn.
system.special: A Wound absorbed by a Temporary Wound qualifies. This debuff occurs after the attack and cannot improve its own hit result.
system.flavor: A follow-through tool that opens a wounded target to the team.
